name: Caminomorisco (Spain)
description: Square white flag with a broad green border, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Caminomorisco (a chequy field and a bend on white).
history: The arms and the flag were approved by the Order of 23 May 1994 published in the Diario Oficial de Extremadura on 9 June 1994, after the municipal council's approval on 4 April 1994; the flag is square, 1:1, white edged green, with the municipal arms at the centre.
